thesis: The site is a hand-drawn map of the moves Boulder makes: every section is a route from one place to another, with start pin, end pin and distance, and the line continues down the page like a long trip through the county.

signature.name: route-line
signature.summary: A continuous SVG path runs along the left margin (desktop) or top edge (mobile) connecting every section as a stop on the route. Each section has a start pin, end pin and distance label in DM Mono. Sticky header shows current segment via data-sw-signature='route-line'. Footer reads 'End of route: you're home.'

motion.intro: Five route lines draw sequentially on stylised Boulder County map, each ending with pin drop; headline fades after lines complete. ≤1.2s, skippable.
stories: Canyon climb: pinned ≥640px, route steepens, elevation counts 5400→8200 ft, truck icon swaps to small box truck. calc(3*55svh+100svh).
Haul stream: items clip-reveal into donate/recycle/landfill columns as route reaches reuse store. No pin.
motion.hover: Hairline underline grows scaleX(0→1) from left, 200ms, spruce color. One language site-wide.
